definition: Luke Zettlemoyer is a professor at the University of Washington and Research Director at Meta FAIR.
details: Co-created RoBERTa, ELMo, semantic parsing frameworks, and leads open foundation model research at UW and Meta.

explainer.lead: Luke Zettlemoyer is a researcher, natural language processing, University of Washington. His work spans natural language processing, machine learning and computational linguistics.

timeline.what: Receives the Presidential Early Career Award for Scientists and Engineers
